reference_model: CLIP STUDIO PAINT 3D drawing figure Ver.2, gray/orange guides
coordinate_system: authored canonical male 1.78m rest space, Z up; named bone heights remap the same stations onto the female source

head.orange: one continuous sagittal surface section: face, crown, occiput, nape
head.gray: one eye-level ring; bilateral side meridians through crown/ear/neck

torso.gray: collar loop plus paired anterior/posterior meridians; no extra upper-chest ring

arm.orange: superior and inferior surfaces in T pose, carried by the skin when posed
arm.gray: anterior/posterior longitudinal meridians and five full transverse sections

leg.orange: paired front/back axes begin at thigh-root section where the torso gray meridians change color
leg.gray: inner/outer side meridians; six transverse sections; no ring through knee center

foot.orange: leg axis continues over instep/toes, heel and sole

limitations: reference and Standin are different meshes; these positions transfer the observed line layout to the existing Standin anatomy
profile reference has an arm selection manipulator; only visible surface lines are used, colored UI handles are excluded
CSP texture/model files were not extracted; lines are newly authored
